title: Unit Event — Over Rad Squad!! — Episode8 On to the Next World

meta.Episode: Episode8 — On to the Next World
meta.Event Outline: The time to surpass RAD WEEKEND has come at last. Kohane is nervous about the task ahead, but musters up her resolve as she looks back on everything she's overcome to get this far. Will Vivid BAD SQUAD finally do it?!

rows.Line: A few days later
Vivid Street
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: They getting another early start today?

rows.Speaker: Record Shop Owner
rows.Line:
Oh, hi!
Out for your morning walk?

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Yeah, but I also wanted to take a look around to see what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know what you mean...
It really is a beautiful sight.

rows.Speaker: Young People
rows.Line:
Guys, bad news...!
All the spots are taken!

rows.Speaker: Young People
rows.Line:
Seriously...?!
Hey, you can't hog all the space like this!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: You should get here earlier instead of acting so salty! You gotta do at least that if you're actually serious about surpassing RAD BLAST!

rows.Speaker: Young People
rows.Line:
What?!
There's no way a bunch of kids like you are gonna surpass it! Let's practice over there, fellas!

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: They really turned this place on its head, huh...?
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Back to the airport already?
You could stay a little while longer.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Unlike a certain someone who's shut down his business, I'm extremely busy.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Hey, cut me some slack.
We used to be partners, remember?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Am I wrong?
Also... I need to get back and start improving on my game.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I was supposed to be the one who saw what was waiting beyond her dream, but now I have more rivals to deal with.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
...
Is that so?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway... Thanks, Ken.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm not holding back against them next time.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Haha. You're always so eager to fight.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We should team back up again.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: They're going to carry Nagi's dream forward now. Also...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: The kids who saw them have already begun the next chase.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I've finished my task of raising the next generation, which means I can become an artist again. So...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: How about it, Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
What about your business?
You're never going to hear the end of it from your wife if you abandon it, right?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I've already talked to her about that. She said to not come back until I'm standing on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Also, unlike you, I'm responsible with my money. RADder fortunately did well enough that An should be fine until she becomes an adult.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: My wife agreed to opening up shop again and having someone trustworthy run things while I'm gone.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: As for An, she just smiled and said, “I guess this means we're rivals now, Dad.”

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Geez, do you know how lucky you are to have a wife and daughter that understanding?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You can still sing, right?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Do you think I'd be asking if I thought I'd be holding you back?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Despite knowing that there's a long gap on your resume... You're on.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Haha. I'm glad I won you over.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, welcome back. Partner.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
What should we call ourselves?
Do you want to pick our team name this time...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Sure, then...
How about something like GODS? That'd make us sound pretty strong.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Wow, you still have the worst taste...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Huh?
If you don't like it, then come up with a better name.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I will.
We'll be called...
Cemetery

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
There.
All that's left is to clean up the incense ashes...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How's that, Aunt Nagi? Sparkling clean, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We've finished cleaning this side too, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Alright, that should be everything!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, it was already pretty clean.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It was.
And there were so many offerings.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm guessing a lot of other people have come by to pay their respects to Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Hey, I fetched us some more water!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Apologies for the wait.
The spigot was further away than we thought.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
I'm also really sorry!
I'm still not used to moving around in a wheelchair.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, that's okay!
We actually just finished cleaning!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, now let's pay our respects.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And lemme introduce you all to her!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look how far we've made it, Aunt Nagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And now we're gonna go see what lies beyond your dream.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna go to all the places and see all the sights you didn't get to.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We wouldn't have been able to come this far without you. So...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You can leave your dream to us now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're going to stand on top of the world. We're going to take on your biggest wish.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll keep watching over us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
That should be enough!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hm? Are you sure?
I thought you'd want to tell her more, like how hard your training was and stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She doesn't need to know about any of that! I wanna look cool in front of her!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Plus, my goal for today was to introduce all of you guys to her!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Right...
And we're definitely glad we came.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, before I forget...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What are you all going to do now?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
That's right...!
I never said!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I want more people to hear me rap, so I'm thinking about uploading some videos online.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Really...?!
I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I mean, I don't have any money, so I'll have to work somewhere around here in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I've already set up my channel, so you guys need to subscribe to it!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Haha. I'll do the next chance I get.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What are your plans, EVER?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We're signing with a major label.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A major label?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We got an offer a little while back.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We thought about sticking to the street, but we want to take this opportunity to spread this neighborhood's music around the world...

rows.Speaker: EVER Member A
rows.Line: Because it's the best music in the world!

rows.Speaker: EVER Member B
rows.Line: I mean, it's a shame that more people don't know about it already.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow, a major label...!
We'll definitely be looking forward to your big debut!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, Tono, what are you gonna do...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Soma and I will be reforming our team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
That's right!
We're getting our team back together. I'm gonna make the tracks and Arata's gonna sing them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that.
Congratulations, both of you.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Signing with a label is an option, but so is staying independent or even going overseas to train. We still have some decisions to make...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: As for the dream Nagi entrusted us with, we'll be chasing it too.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: You aren't the only ones who want to conquer the world. So do we, which means we'll be rivals from here on out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Is that so?
Then, we'll be looking forward to meeting you again.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, so will we.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Anyway, what are your plans, Vivid BAD SQUAD?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You already know the answer to that question.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna see what lies beyond Aunt Nagi's dream!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
She entrusted her dream to us...
But we also want to go see the world beyond it.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
To stand on top of the world, huh...?
I have no idea how you guys are actually gonna do that...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
But I have a feeling that you'll succeed.
I mean, you've got the singing skills to do it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Us standing on top of the world...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Mita has a point...
I have no idea how we're actually going to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But I'm not worried.
I'm sure we'll figure out a way.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We've been able to overcome all the obstacles that have stood in our way.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Standing on top of the world...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Just thinking about what that view's going to look like fills me with so much excitement!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An! Shinonome! Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to see what it's like from up there as soon as possible!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You said it, partner!
That's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, let's start heading towards our next goal!

rows.Speaker: Akito, Kohane & Toya
rows.Line:
Okay!
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see what we get to see next!)

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: 03_street_ed3
Nagi could definitely trust those guys with her dream.

Yeah...
It was a good event.
Vivid BAD SQUAD, huh...?
